```{r setup, include=FALSE}
library(tidyverse)
library(lubridate)
library(knitr)

knitr::opts_chunk$set(
  echo = FALSE,
  warning = FALSE,
  message = FALSE,
  fig.width = 9,
  fig.height = 5
)
```

# Purpose

Three checks suggested by Franco Mascayano (November 2026), run before writing the Aim 1 models:

1. **Count check.** Applying the Aim 1 steps to people born 1992–2012 and diagnosed 2005–2022, with no age limits, should give a count close to the **14,410** confirmed cases in the urbanicity paper. A count well below that would suggest the confirmed/discarded filters are dropping cases.
2. **The 2005 half year.** The GES guarantee for schizophrenia started on **July 1, 2005**, so 2005 covers about half a year and may include a backlog of people already ill.
3. **Trend by country of origin.** Migration grew after 2015, mostly among young adults. Does the rise in age at case creation hold among people born in Chile?

All output is aggregate. Only the data path below needs to change.

```{r import-data, include=FALSE}
# ============================================================
# FILE PATH — UPDATE BEFORE RUNNING ON THE REAL DATA
# ============================================================
data_file <- "data/raw/synthetic_data.csv"

# ============================================================
# IMPORT — NO CHANGES NEEDED BELOW HERE
# ============================================================
stopifnot(file.exists(data_file))

dat <- read_csv(
  data_file,
  col_types = cols(.default = col_character()),
  show_col_types = FALSE
)
```

```{r prepare, include=FALSE}
# Registry dates are DDMMMYYYY (e.g., 27JAN2005), as in 03a and 04.
parse_creation_date <- function(x) {
  x <- trimws(as.character(x))
  x[x == ""] <- NA_character_
  as.Date(parse_date(x, format = "%d%b%Y", locale = locale("en")))
}

normalize_code <- function(x) {
  x <- trimws(as.character(x))
  x[x == ""] <- NA_character_
  sub("^([0-9]+)\\.0+$", "\\1", x)
}

records <- dat %>%
  mutate(
    source_row = row_number(),
    creation_date = parse_creation_date(fecha_creacion_caso),
    creation_year = year(creation_date),
    age_at_creation = suppressWarnings(as.numeric(edad_ano_creacion_caso)),
    confirmed = toupper(trimws(ipd_cofirmado)),
    discarded = toupper(trimws(ipd_descartado)),
    confirmed_b = confirmed %in% "SI" & discarded %in% "NO",
    non_discarded = discarded %in% "NO"
  ) %>%
  filter(!is.na(id_persona), trimws(id_persona) != "")

# Records whose date cannot be read are counted and set aside, as in
# 03a. The real data has had none; synthetic data may include some.
n_records_read <- nrow(records)
n_unreadable_dates <- sum(is.na(records$creation_date))
records <- records %>% filter(!is.na(creation_date))

earliest <- function(d) {
  d %>%
    arrange(id_persona, creation_date, source_row) %>%
    group_by(id_persona) %>%
    slice(1) %>%
    ungroup()
}

# Option B: each person's earliest confirmed, non-discarded record.
option_b <- records %>% filter(confirmed_b) %>% earliest()
stopifnot(nrow(option_b) == n_distinct(option_b$id_persona))
```

# Data check

```{r data-check}
kable(
  tibble(
    Measure = c(
      "Records read (with a person ID)",
      "Records with a date that could not be read (set aside)",
      "Records used"
    ),
    N = c(n_records_read, n_unreadable_dates, nrow(records))
  ),
  caption = "Records used in these checks"
)

if (n_unreadable_dates > 0) {
  cat("Note: some case-creation dates could not be read as DDMMMYYYY",
      "(e.g., 27JAN2005). Earlier real-data runs had none.\n")
}
```

# Check 1: Count compared with the urbanicity paper

The extract has no date of birth, so birth year is estimated as **calendar year of case creation − age at case creation**. Because age is in completed years, a person's true birth year is either that value or one year earlier. The table therefore gives the main estimate plus a lower and upper bound:

- **Lower bound:** both possible birth years fall within 1992–2012.
- **Upper bound:** either possible birth year falls within 1992–2012.

Diagnosis year is the calendar year of the index record, restricted to 2005–2022. No age limits are applied.

Because it is not yet confirmed exactly how 14,410 was counted, the same check is shown under several definitions. The first row is the Aim 1 definition.

```{r count-check}
birth_window <- c(1992, 2012)
dx_window <- c(2005, 2022)
reference_n <- 14410

count_cohort <- function(index_records) {
  d <- index_records %>%
    filter(between(creation_year, dx_window[1], dx_window[2])) %>%
    mutate(
      birth_a = creation_year - age_at_creation,  # main estimate
      birth_b = birth_a - 1,                      # one year earlier
      in_a = between(birth_a, birth_window[1], birth_window[2]),
      in_b = between(birth_b, birth_window[1], birth_window[2])
    )

  tibble(
    Main_estimate = sum(d$in_a),
    Lower_bound = sum(d$in_a & d$in_b),
    Upper_bound = sum(d$in_a | d$in_b)
  )
}

# Definition 2: people ever confirmed, indexed at their first record
# of any status (rather than their first confirmed record).
ever_confirmed_ids <- unique(records$id_persona[records$confirmed_b])
first_any_confirmed_people <- records %>%
  filter(id_persona %in% ever_confirmed_ids) %>%
  earliest()

# Definition 3: Option C, earliest non-discarded record.
option_c <- records %>% filter(non_discarded) %>% earliest()

# Definition 4: every confirmed record (not one per person).
confirmed_records <- records %>% filter(confirmed_b)

count_table <- bind_rows(
  count_cohort(option_b) %>%
    mutate(Definition = "Aim 1 (Option B): earliest confirmed, non-discarded record per person"),
  count_cohort(first_any_confirmed_people) %>%
    mutate(Definition = "Ever-confirmed people, indexed at their first record of any status"),
  count_cohort(option_c) %>%
    mutate(Definition = "Option C: earliest non-discarded record per person"),
  count_cohort(confirmed_records) %>%
    mutate(Definition = "All confirmed records (not one per person)")
) %>%
  mutate(
    Difference_from_14410 = Main_estimate - reference_n,
    Percent_of_14410 = round(100 * Main_estimate / reference_n, 1)
  ) %>%
  select(Definition, Main_estimate, Lower_bound, Upper_bound,
         Difference_from_14410, Percent_of_14410)

kable(
  count_table,
  col.names = c("Definition", "Main estimate", "Lower bound", "Upper bound",
                "Difference from 14,410", "% of 14,410"),
  caption = "People born 1992-2012 and diagnosed 2005-2022, no age limits"
)
```

## Aim 1 definition by diagnosis year

If the count is below 14,410, this shows whether the shortfall is spread evenly or concentrated in certain years.

```{r count-by-year}
option_b %>%
  filter(between(creation_year, dx_window[1], dx_window[2])) %>%
  mutate(birth_a = creation_year - age_at_creation) %>%
  filter(between(birth_a, birth_window[1], birth_window[2])) %>%
  count(creation_year, name = "N") %>%
  kable(
    col.names = c("Diagnosis year", "N"),
    caption = "Aim 1 definition, born 1992-2012 (main estimate), by diagnosis year"
  )
```

# Check 2: The 2005 half year

## Registrations by month, 2004–2006

All registry records, regardless of status, followed by Aim 1 index records.

```{r monthly-counts}
monthly_all <- records %>%
  filter(between(creation_year, 2004, 2006)) %>%
  mutate(month = floor_date(creation_date, "month")) %>%
  count(month, name = "All_records")

monthly_b <- option_b %>%
  filter(
    between(creation_year, 2004, 2006),
    between(age_at_creation, 15, 65)
  ) %>%
  mutate(month = floor_date(creation_date, "month")) %>%
  group_by(month) %>%
  summarise(
    Aim1_index_records = n(),
    Aim1_mean_age = round(mean(age_at_creation), 1),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

monthly <- full_join(monthly_all, monthly_b, by = "month") %>%
  arrange(month) %>%
  mutate(
    across(c(All_records, Aim1_index_records), ~ replace_na(.x, 0L)),
    month = format(month, "%Y-%m")
  )

kable(
  monthly,
  col.names = c("Month", "All records", "Aim 1 index records", "Aim 1 mean age"),
  caption = "Registrations by month, 2004-2006 (Aim 1 columns use ages 15-65)"
)

ggplot(monthly, aes(x = month, y = All_records)) +
  geom_col() +
  labs(
    title = "All registry records by month, 2004-2006",
    x = NULL,
    y = "Records"
  ) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 90, vjust = 0.5, size = 7))
```

## Aim 1 cohort: first and second half of 2005

```{r half-year}
aim1 <- option_b %>%
  filter(
    between(age_at_creation, 15, 65),
    between(creation_year, 2005, 2023)
  )

aim1 %>%
  filter(creation_year %in% c(2005, 2006)) %>%
  mutate(
    Period = case_when(
      creation_year == 2005 & creation_date < as.Date("2005-07-01") ~ "2005, Jan-Jun",
      creation_year == 2005 ~ "2005, Jul-Dec",
      TRUE ~ "2006 (full year)"
    )
  ) %>%
  group_by(Period) %>%
  summarise(
    N = n(),
    Mean_age = round(mean(age_at_creation), 1),
    Median_age = median(age_at_creation),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  kable(
    col.names = c("Period", "N", "Mean age", "Median age"),
    caption = "Aim 1 cohort around the start of the GES guarantee"
  )
```

## Does 2005 change the overall trend?

Unadjusted linear trend in age at case creation (years of age per calendar year), with and without 2005. This is a quick check only, not the Aim 1 model.

```{r trend-without-2005}
slope_row <- function(d, label) {
  fit <- lm(age_at_creation ~ creation_year, data = d)
  ci <- confint(fit)["creation_year", ]
  tibble(
    Sample = label,
    N = nrow(d),
    Change_per_year = round(coef(fit)[["creation_year"]], 3),
    CI_lower = round(ci[[1]], 3),
    CI_upper = round(ci[[2]], 3)
  )
}

bind_rows(
  slope_row(aim1, "All years, 2005-2023"),
  slope_row(filter(aim1, creation_year >= 2006), "Excluding 2005 (2006-2023)")
) %>%
  kable(
    col.names = c("Sample", "N", "Change in mean age per year", "95% CI lower", "95% CI upper"),
    caption = "Unadjusted trend with and without 2005"
  )
```

# Check 3: Trend by country of origin

Country-of-origin code 0 is treated as missing (working assumption, 2026-11-20). Countries with few cases are grouped as "Other" to avoid very small cells.

```{r country-prep, include=FALSE}
aim1 <- aim1 %>%
  mutate(
    country_code = normalize_code(cmd_cod_pais_origen),
    country_group = case_when(
      is.na(country_code) | country_code == "0" ~ "Missing",
      country_code == "152" ~ "Chile",
      country_code == "604" ~ "Peru",
      country_code == "862" ~ "Venezuela",
      country_code == "170" ~ "Colombia",
      country_code == "68"  ~ "Bolivia",
      country_code == "332" ~ "Haiti",
      TRUE ~ "Other"
    ),
    born_in_chile = case_when(
      country_group == "Missing" ~ NA,
      TRUE ~ country_group == "Chile"
    ),
    period = if_else(creation_year <= 2014, "2005-2014", "2015-2023")
  )
```

## Country of origin by period

```{r country-by-period}
aim1 %>%
  group_by(country_group, period) %>%
  summarise(
    N = n(),
    Mean_age = round(mean(age_at_creation), 1),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  pivot_wider(
    names_from = period,
    values_from = c(N, Mean_age),
    values_fill = list(N = 0L)
  ) %>%
  arrange(desc(`N_2015-2023`)) %>%
  kable(
    col.names = c("Country of origin", "N 2005-2014", "N 2015-2023",
                  "Mean age 2005-2014", "Mean age 2015-2023"),
    caption = "Aim 1 cohort by country of origin and period"
  )
```

## Annual mean age: everyone vs born in Chile

```{r chile-only-trend}
annual_compare <- bind_rows(
  aim1 %>% mutate(Group = "Everyone"),
  aim1 %>% filter(born_in_chile %in% TRUE) %>% mutate(Group = "Born in Chile"),
  aim1 %>% filter(born_in_chile %in% FALSE) %>% mutate(Group = "Born outside Chile")
) %>%
  group_by(Group, creation_year) %>%
  summarise(
    N = n(),
    Mean_age = round(mean(age_at_creation), 1),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

annual_compare %>%
  pivot_wider(
    names_from = Group,
    values_from = c(N, Mean_age),
    values_fill = list(N = 0L)
  ) %>%
  select(
    creation_year,
    `N_Everyone`, `Mean_age_Everyone`,
    `N_Born in Chile`, `Mean_age_Born in Chile`,
    `N_Born outside Chile`, `Mean_age_Born outside Chile`
  ) %>%
  kable(
    col.names = c("Year", "N, everyone", "Mean age, everyone",
                  "N, born in Chile", "Mean age, born in Chile",
                  "N, born outside Chile", "Mean age, born outside Chile"),
    caption = "Annual mean age at case creation by country of origin"
  )

ggplot(
  annual_compare,
  aes(x = creation_year, y = Mean_age, color = Group)
) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 0.8) +
  geom_point(size = 1.2) +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = seq(2005, 2023, 2)) +
  labs(
    title = "Mean age at case creation by country of origin",
    x = "Calendar year",
    y = "Mean age (years)",
    color = NULL
  ) +
  theme_minimal()
```

## Trend with and without people born outside Chile

```{r chile-only-slope}
bind_rows(
  slope_row(aim1, "Everyone"),
  slope_row(filter(aim1, born_in_chile %in% TRUE), "Born in Chile only"),
  slope_row(filter(aim1, born_in_chile %in% TRUE, creation_year >= 2006),
            "Born in Chile only, excluding 2005")
) %>%
  kable(
    col.names = c("Sample", "N", "Change in mean age per year", "95% CI lower", "95% CI upper"),
    caption = "Unadjusted trend by country-of-origin restriction"
  )
```
